tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Aquemi Navy, the colour of the wordmark. Primary brand colour: the logo, primary buttons, full-bleed brand bands and the footer. In dark mode it lifts slightly so bands still separate from `surface`.

tokens.name: limestone
tokens.usage: Limestone, the warm ground the wordmark was drawn on. Secondary brand colour: quiet section bands, the reversed logo on `navy`, and the primary button fill in dark mode. Never a page background behind long text in `ink-subtle`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, form fields and menus that sit above `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: table header rows, code and spec blocks, alternating sections.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `limestone`. 13:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions and table labels on every surface, `limestone` included (6:1+).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Metadata, timestamps, placeholder text on `surface` and `surface-raised` only (4.6:1+). Too weak on `limestone` (4.2:1): use `ink-muted` there.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `navy` fills in light mode and on `limestone` button fills in dark mode.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and table rules. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Form-field borders, diagram strokes and any border that must be seen (3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised`). Falls to 2.8:1 on `limestone`: don't put fields there.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and selected states. Navy in light mode, Limestone in dark mode. Pair with `on-action`.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label colour on `action` and `action-hover` (11:1+).

tokens.name: flow
tokens.usage: Flow Blue, the single accent. Inline links, chart lines, live readings and the one highlighted figure on a page. Never a large fill. 5.6:1+ on `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: flow-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a selected table row or highlighted spec. Text on it stays `ink`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: In-spec results and completed qualification steps. Always paired with the word (Pass, In spec) or a check icon.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Alert-limit readings and pending items. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Action-limit excursions and errors. Always with a word or icon; differs from `pass` in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: caution-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind draft placeholders and alert-limit notes. Text on it uses `ink`.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on `navy` bands and the footer, in both themes.

tokens.name: on-navy-muted
tokens.usage: Lead text, links and captions on `navy` bands and the footer (9:1 on navy).

tokens.name: on-limestone
tokens.usage: Text on `limestone` bands. Limestone stays light in dark mode, so this stays dark.

tokens.name: on-limestone-muted
tokens.usage: Lead text on `limestone` bands (6.4:1).

styles.name: display-xl

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutter; padding inside panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; heading to body gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between related blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Space above and below the hero.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Brand bands, images, tables. The default: Aquemi is square-edged.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, panels.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Standard tags only (USP, EP, ASME BPE).

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs and popovers only. Everything else separates with `line`, not shadow.

tokens.name: content-max
